ruleset.name: Test anti-patterns
ruleset.description: Anti-patterns in existing tests, for the find-test-anti-patterns skill.

rule.name: no_real_assertion__NoAssertion
rule.message: The test has no assertion: no assert, verify, check, expect, fail or should call, and no call to a method in its class that asserts

property.name: xpath
property.value: //MethodDeclaration [ModifierList/Annotation[@SimpleName=('Test','ParameterizedTest','RepeatedTest')][not(.//MemberValuePair[@Name='expected'])] or (starts-with(@Name,'test') and @Visibility='public' and not(ModifierList/Annotation) and ancestor::ClassDeclaration[1]/ExtendsList/ClassType[@SimpleName=('TestCase','AbstractDependencyInjectionSpringContextTests', 'AbstractTransactionalSpringContextTests','AbstractTransactionalDataSourceSpringContextTests','AbstractSpringContextTests', 'AbstractJpaTests','AbstractJUnit38SpringContextTests','AbstractTransactionalJUnit38SpringContextTests')])] [not(.//MethodCall[matches(@MethodName,'^(assert|verify|check|expect|fail|should|andExpect|then)')])] [not(.//MethodCall[@MethodName = ancestor::ClassBody[1]/MethodDeclaration [.//MethodCall[matches(@MethodName,'^(assert|verify|check|expect|fail|should|andExpect)')]]/@Name])]

rule.name: disabled__Ignored
rule.message: A test, or its whole class, marked @Ignore or @Disabled

rule.name: never_runs__IgnoredWithoutTest
rule.message: Marked @Ignore or @Disabled but has no test annotation: it never runs

rule.name: never_runs__DetachedTest
rule.message: Looks like a test but has no test annotation, isn't a JUnit 3 test, and nothing in its class calls it: it never runs

property.name: xpath
property.value: //ClassDeclaration[not(ExtendsList/ClassType[@SimpleName=('TestCase','AbstractDependencyInjectionSpringContextTests', 'AbstractTransactionalSpringContextTests','AbstractTransactionalDataSourceSpringContextTests','AbstractSpringContextTests', 'AbstractJpaTests','AbstractJUnit38SpringContextTests','AbstractTransactionalJUnit38SpringContextTests','GroovyTestCase', 'MockObjectTestCase')])] [.//MethodDeclaration/ModifierList/Annotation[@SimpleName=('Test','ParameterizedTest','RepeatedTest','TestFactory')] or ends-with(@SimpleName,'Test') or ends-with(@SimpleName,'Tests') or ends-with(@SimpleName,'TestCase')] /ClassBody/MethodDeclaration[@Visibility='public'][@Void=true()][count(FormalParameters/*)=0] [starts-with(@Name,'test') or ../MethodDeclaration/ModifierList/Annotation[@SimpleName=('Test','ParameterizedTest','RepeatedTest','TestFactory')]] [not(ModifierList/Annotation)] [not(@Name=('setUp','tearDown','main'))] [not(@Name = ancestor::ClassBody//MethodCall/@MethodName)]

rule.name: never_runs__JupiterSilentSkip
rule.message: A JUnit 5 or 6 test that is private, static or returns a value: JUnit skips it without a word

rule.name: swallows_failures__CatchesAssertionError
rule.message: A test catches AssertionError, Error or Throwable, which swallows its own failures

rule.name: no_real_assertion__BareAssertThatOrVerify
rule.message: assertThat(x) or verify(mock) with nothing after it checks nothing

rule.name: no_real_assertion__WeakAssertionsOnly
rule.message: The test's only assertions are assertNotNull, isNotNull or assertTrue(true)

property.name: xpath
property.value: //MethodDeclaration[ModifierList/Annotation[@SimpleName=('Test','ParameterizedTest','RepeatedTest')]] [.//MethodCall[@MethodName=('assertNotNull','isNotNull') or (@MethodName='assertTrue' and ArgumentList/BooleanLiteral)]] [not(.//MethodCall[(starts-with(@MethodName,'assert') and not(@MethodName=('assertNotNull','assertTrue','assertThat'))) or @MethodName=('fail','verify','assertThrows')])] [not(.//MethodCall[@MethodName='assertTrue'][not(ArgumentList/BooleanLiteral)])] [not(.//MethodCall[@MethodName='assertThat'][parent::MethodCall or count(ArgumentList/*)>1])]

rule.name: no_real_assertion__ExpectedAnyException
rule.message: @Test(expected = Exception.class or Throwable.class) passes whatever goes wrong

rule.name: sleeps__Sleep
rule.message: Thread.sleep or TimeUnit sleep in test code

rule.name: order_dependent__FixedOrder
rule.message: The class fixes the order its tests run in

rule.name: mocks_everything__FiveOrMoreMocks
rule.message: The class has five or more mocks
